question: Why did the optimization of the hydroquinone-catechol vacuum distillation raise the distillate-to-feed ratio above the industrial baseline?
expect: premise false: D/F was REDUCED from 0.121 to 0.092 (abstract)
rendered:
Document: Rigorous Modeling and Industrial-Scalable Optimization of Hydroquinone-Catechol Vacuum Distillation: Aspen Plus-RSM Integration for Thermally Labile Systems

The optimization of the hydroquinone-catechol vacuum distillation raised the distillate-to-feed ratio above the industrial baseline because the optimal distillate-to-feed (D/F) ratio of 0.092 was determined through preliminary material balance calculations and target separation requirements, aiming to effectively enrich catechol in the distillate while maintaining high-purity hydroquinone in the bottoms.
